_comment: Copy to .lingcowork/mcp.json and edit. That path is gitignored because
this file holds API keys and Authorization headers.
改动保存后立即生效，不需要重启：只有变化的条目会被重连。
Fields:
command / args / env / cwd  - stdio server; the transport is inferred
url / headers               - HTTP server (streamable HTTP, falls back to SSE)
enabled                     - omit for enabled; set false to keep an entry without connecting
trustAnnotations            - believe this server when it calls a tool read-only.
Off by default: annotations are self-reported, so an
untrusted server's read-only claim buys nothing.
autoApprove                 - remote tool names (as the server publishes them, NOT the
prefixed name the model sees) to run without a prompt.
initTimeoutSec              - handshake budget; raise it for a server that installs on first run
auth                        - "oauth" runs the authorization code flow. HTTP servers only:
a stdio child process has nowhere to put a bearer token.
oauth                       - optional. Omit the whole block for the usual case — the client
registers itself dynamically and the result is stored locally.
Tokens live in data/interview.db, never in this file.
clientId / clientSecret   - only when you registered a client by hand
scopes                    - what to ask for
redirectUri               - defaults to http://localhost:9001/mcp/oauth/callback.
Override when the provider insists on 127.0.0.1, or when a
hand-registered client declared something else. Whatever you
put here must match the registration exactly.
